data.narrative:
Code Metal, a Series B defense and security company, commands a current post-money valuation of $1.25B after raising $161M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Twenty ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B).

Two valuation methods triangulate on Code Metal's fair value. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $2.4B. Peer-median analysis across the 7-company same-stage, same-sector cohort produces $1.0B, with observed valuations spanning $300M to $3.0B. The median peer valuation of $1.0B sits notably below Code Metal's current $1.25B mark, suggesting either premium positioning or valuation inflation relative to the peer set.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $850M (low) to $2.7B (high), with a median cross-method estimate of $1.7B. Code Metal's current $1.25B valuation aligns toward the lower quartile of this range. Key uncertainties include whether Code Metal commands true defensibility premiums over the median peer and whether the stage-progression multiplier appropriately captures sector-specific funding dynamics in defense technology.
